description: This Java class defines a final class TenantObjectWithAuthId that encapsulates a TenantObject and an authentication id (authId). It provides constructor and getter methods, ensuring the immutability of its fields. The class is part of the org.eclipse.hono.service.tenant package, serving as a data holder for tenant identification and authentication info.

classes.name: TenantObjectWithAuthId
classes.description: A final class that encapsulates a TenantObject and an authentication ID, providing immutable access to these fields.

methods.name: TenantObjectWithAuthId
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the tenantObject and authId fields, enforcing non-null constraints.

methods.name: getTenantObject
methods.description: Returns the tenantObject associated with this instance.

methods.name: getAuthId
methods.description: Returns the authentication ID or device ID for this tenant object.
